review.reviewer_scope: Read-only independent audit; no canonical data, app, Sites or Git mutations.
review.method: Read category definitions and scan all canonical route-stage labels/sequences for function overlap with M82–M88. Compare required/alternative/optional operation semantics; verify named devices against manufacturer documentation and inspect cached primary research methods for casting cases.

recommendations.reason: M46 supplies purified rinse water; it is not the workstation/fixture performing substrate rinsing. An M85 wet-processing/rinse station is the closer functional planning class. M46 remains optional water-source support, M18 optional drying. The source itself labels the operation M46 rinse, so retain original source statement as provenance and mark this as a curator correction.
recommendations.local_source: work/source_pdf.txt, P05 D; supplied PDF page24
recommendations.compatibility: Existing M85 records all carry wafer_wet_processing subtype. They are candidates for a configured substrate-rinse workstation, not validated electrochemical coupon compatibility. Require holder geometry, coating compatibility, rinse chemistry, DI plumbing and exhaust review; do not assert every M85 catalog model fits.

recommendations.reason: Wet development and dry residual-layer clearing are distinct alternatives. M85 fills the previously empty wet-development branch. M61 remains correct for plasma/etch clearing.
recommendations.local_source: work/source_pdf.txt, P06 C; supplied PDF page25
recommendations.compatibility: Use wet-processing subtype; select solvent- versus acid-compatible construction for the actual resist developer. No class-level model validation.

recommendations.reason: The deposition/lift-off branch needs deposition hardware and wet lift-off handling. M85 belongs to wet lift-off and does not replace M23 deposition or M61 etching on the alternative branch.
recommendations.local_source: work/source_pdf.txt, P06 D; supplied PDF page25
recommendations.compatibility: Wafer_wet_processing subtype with resist-strip chemistry review; preserve branch dependency with prior patterning choice.

recommendations.reason: Methods explicitly cast mixtures in glass Petri dishes then dry the casts in a vacuum oven. M87 supplies the casting fixture; it cannot replace M18 vacuum drying.
recommendations.compatibility: Select a casting_fixture subtype or suitable dish geometry; ambient-drying enclosures alone cannot satisfy the casting fixture or vacuum-drying requirement.

recommendations.reason: Methods describe high-speed homogeneous stirring and pouring acid sol into a culture dish. A casting fixture is additional to mixing. M87 does not replace stirring. Stirrer geometry remains curator planning and must not be asserted as reported.
recommendations.compatibility: Casting fixture must resist the stated acid medium. Keep gelation/solvent exchange distinct in the next stage.

recommendations.reason: Methods explicitly pour the mixture into a release-coated mould and cure it in an oven. M87 fits the mould/fixture component; it cannot replace M71 thermal curing.
recommendations.compatibility: Mould geometry, release layer and temperature compatibility need review. Ambient-drying stations do not replace thermal curing.

recommendations.reason: Source says fill containers and permits M17 drying only for a validated formulation. M82 is a reasonable optional pipetting/dispensing aid for container filling, not a universal mandatory requirement; manual pouring remains possible. M17 remains a separate formulation-dependent optional preservation operation.
recommendations.local_source: work/source_pdf.txt, N06 E; supplied PDF page11
recommendations.compatibility: No filling apparatus/model is asserted by the supplied source. Volume, dispersion stability, sterility and fluid-contact compatibility need review.

retain_cases.reason: Official Tecan Centris documentation identifies a syringe pump module. Reagent dispensing wording does not make its existing specific mechanism wrong.
Robot handles vessels/finished samples; this is not pipetting. Preserve robot class.
805 Dosimat dosing and titration is the specific existing apparatus class. An external DAQ may be an optional control component but is not a replacement for the dosing hardware.
Diffusion-based dialysis solvent exchange uses a membrane assembly, not generic batch wet processing. Similar solvent-exchange verbs are insufficient for substitution.
Metal melting/casting plus heat homogenization differs from unheated casting fixtures and ambient drying; preserve current physical operations and configuration review.
Powder dosing/loading is preparation, SPS is consolidation. New M88 does not replace the SPS machine.
Nanoparticle quenching in a laser-ablation reaction medium is not macroscopic hot-rod immersion quenching. Laser and chamber functions remain.
A potentiostat/galvanostat directly performs electrochemical control; generic DAQ does not replace its required regulated functionality.

Capability-only wet chemical etching and dry plasma etching retain M61 etched-material-removal function. A wet bench may be support for one configuration but is not categorically a substitute for an etching reactor.

review.no_forced_substitutions: No global replace was justified for centrifugal/filtration recovery, pump feeding, optical sensing, metal casting, furnaces or sintering. New classes fill distinct functions; class names are not interchangeable with generic action verbs.
review.provenance_note: All recommendations are planning classifications. Preserve source-authored wording and references separately, with curator decisions and model suitability reviews.

solvent_capability_evidence.scope: Manufacturer family-level solvent and photoresist-stripping use, with configurable station features. Does not certify an arbitrary polypropylene bench or every chemistry.
